data.investment_objective: The primary investment objective of the scheme is to generate consistent long-term returns by investing in equity and equity-related instruments of banking and ﬁnancial services companies and other related sectors/companies. The fund aims to capitalize on the growth opportunities and growth potential of various sub-sectors within the BFSI sector, including (but not limited to) banks, NBFCs, insurance companies, asset management companies, capital market participants, ﬁntech players etc. (This includes companies beneﬁting from or contributing to the growth of the banking and ﬁnancial services sector). However, there is no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved. The Scheme does not assure or guarantee any returns
